evidence.text: Retrained the gradient-boosted fraud model on 2022 data and recalibrated its alert thresholds with the fraud strategy managers over a series of threshold workshops.

evidence.text: Work sample: notes from the threshold workshops, with the alert-rate options considered, the chosen operating point of 0.5% of transactions alerted, and the fraud strategy managers' sign-off on the recalibrated thresholds.

At a fixed alert rate of 0.5%, it records card-not-present fraud value detected rising from 61% (January to March 2023) to 74% (July to September 2023), after the retrained model went into use in May 2023.
